items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about Satchell Paige and Josh Gibson ('He told Satchell Paige... And so Satch said okay'), but does not describe a personal interaction or relationship with Satchell Paige himself.

ctx.x: That’s right. He brought a baseball bat. We used to do this Satch and Josh thing, with the two pianos. And one night he came out on the stage and Norman said, “and on the two pianos we have Oscar Peterson and Bill Basie, would you welcome them?” I walked up from this end and Basie walked from the other. He had a baseball bat.

For those of you who don’t quite understand, I must explain. You see, Basie and Oscar did a thing together. And the Satch — they told this story about Satchell Paige and Josh Gibson who was the greatest hitter I guess in baseball at the time, Negro baseball. He told Satchell Paige he said, “My mother and father are coming to watch me play. And at some point, Satchell, would you please let me hit one?” You know.
